roadmap.title: Eidos 7 and early story
roadmap.description: Clear the opening area and first bosses. Learn Perfect Dodge, Perfect Parry, Ambush, and Beta skills as soon as the skill tree opens.

roadmap.title: Wasteland, Altess Levoire, and Matrix 11
roadmap.description: Finish Altess Levoire and Matrix 11. Unlock Burst skills and Tachy Mode and start counting dodges, parries, and skill kills.

roadmap.title: Great Desert and Abyss Levoire
roadmap.description: Do the Great Desert quests, then finish Abyss Levoire. This is the first point of no return, so finish Xion collectibles and side quests first.

roadmap.title: Collect everything before Spire 4
roadmap.description: Clear side quests, fish, cans, camps, Naytiba entries, records, boxes, Nano Suits, Exospines, and upgrade items. Visit Eidos 9 so Making New Memories and the Cocoon Naytiba stay available.

roadmap.title: Spire 4 and the first ending
roadmap.description: Finish the Spire 4 bosses, then reach the Nest. Take Adam's hand for Making New Memories, or refuse for Return to the Colony.

roadmap.title: New Game+ cleanup
roadmap.description: Start New Game+ and rush the story without collectibles for Cost of Lost Memories, finish the run, and learn the 12 New Game+ skills.

achievements.description: You have unlocked all achievements in the main game.
achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement in the game.

guide.context: Difficulty does not matter, so Story Mode works. You need two playthroughs because the two Memories endings cannot be earned in the same one.

steps.text: Finish the other 44 achievements; play the first run for @item{Making New Memories} and use @mechanic{New Game+} for @item{Cost of Lost Memories}.
Reach and activate the first Camp during the opening story; it cannot be missed.
Beat @enemy{Abaddon} on top of the parking garage in @loc{Eidos 7} during the story.
Beat @enemy{Corrupter} in @loc{Eidos 7}, just after you receive the Hyper Cell.
Beat @enemy{Gigas} in the Crater, the last stop of @loc{Eidos 7}.
Start the side quest "Life of the Scavengers" in the @loc{Wasteland}.
Beat @enemy{Brute} during that quest.

achievements.description: Retrieve the Hyper Cell from Altess Levoire.
achievements.summary: Retrieve the Hyper Cell at the end of Altess Levoire.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Altess Levoire}, beat the Maelstrom at the end, and take the Hyper Cell.

guide.context: Beating Stalker also unlocks Burst skills.

steps.text: Enter the Rail Yard in @loc{Matrix 11} and beat @enemy{Stalker}.
Ride the huge cargo elevator down in @loc{Matrix 11} and beat @enemy{Juggernaut} at the base.

guide.context: Beating Tachy also unlocks Tachy Mode.

steps.text: Reach the Contaminated Water Purification Plant in @loc{Matrix 11} and beat @enemy{Tachy}.

guide.context: The quest "Encounter" needs two things first: the Alpha Naytiba in @loc{Matrix 11} must be dead, and "The Scavenger's Story" must be done.

steps.text: Finish "The Scavenger's Story" from Kaya.
Start "Encounter" in the @loc{Great Desert} and beat @enemy{Behemoth}.

achievements.description: Retrieve the Hyper Cell from Abyss Levoire.
achievements.summary: Retrieve the Hyper Cell at the end of Abyss Levoire.

guide.context: Finishing this area is the first point of no return. Do the Xion side quests and collectibles first.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Abyss Levoire}, beat the Maelstrom at the end, and take the Hyper Cell.
Beat @enemy{Belial}, the boss that closes out the Space Center in @loc{Spire 4}.
Beat @enemy{Karakuri} in the Vermillion Garden in @loc{Spire 4}.
Beat @enemy{Demogorgon} at the Central Core in @loc{Spire 4}.
Beat @enemy{Raven} in the @loc{Wasteland}, right outside the nest.

achievements.description: Reach the Return to the Colony ending.
achievements.summary: Refuse Adam's offer at the final choice, which always ends the story with the Colony ending.

guide.context: This ending is always available at the choice, whatever you did earlier. The last 3 Naytiba entries are locked behind it.

steps.text: Reach the ending decision in the Nest.
Do not take @npc{Adam}'s hand.
Win the fight against the Elder Naytiba.

achievements.description: Reach the Cost of Lost Memories ending.
achievements.summary: Accept Adam's offer at the final choice while Lily's bar is under 100%, which ends the story with the lost-memories ending.

guide.context: Lily's bar fills when you pick up Memory Sticks and Documents. You cannot check it, so skip them and side quests. If you go from Abyss Levoire straight to Spire 4 without visiting Eidos 9, you are on this path. A New Game+ run is the easiest time to do this.

steps.text: Rush the story and skip side quests and Memory Sticks or Documents.
Go from @loc{Abyss Levoire} to @loc{Spire 4} without visiting @loc{Eidos 9}.
At the decision in the Nest, take @npc{Adam}'s hand and beat Providence.

achievements.description: Reach the Making New Memories ending.
achievements.summary: Accept Adam's offer at the final choice while Lily's bar is full, which ends the story with the new-memories ending.

guide.context: Lily's bar fills when you pick up Memory Sticks and Documents. Visiting Eidos 9 before Spire 4 shows that this path is active. This is the best ending for a first playthrough.

steps.text: Collect all Memory Sticks and Documents until Lily asks you to go to @loc{Eidos 9}.
Visit @loc{Eidos 9}, then finish @loc{Spire 4}.
At the decision in the Nest, take @npc{Adam}'s hand and beat Providence.

guide.context: There are no cans in Altess Levoire, Abyss Levoire, or Eidos 9. Collect Xion's cans before you finish Abyss Levoire, because that locks you out of Xion's city. Collect all other cans before you finish Spire 4.

steps.text: Check the vending machine in the Xion Safehouse to see how many cans you have.
Find the missing cans in the other areas; some need a quest or a shot, for example the Eidos 7 can needs "Oblivion" to drain the flooded area.
Claim each reward at the vending machine as you pass a threshold; the 49th can earns the Black Pearl Nano Suit.

guide.context: Of the 40 Nano Suits, 5 are rewards you do not collect, so about 35 can be collected. New Game+ adds colour variants.

steps.text: Collect suits during the story and side content, including the Black Pearl suit for gathering all 49 cans.
Finish the missing ones in @mechanic{New Game+} if you miss any.

achievements.description: Collected 200 Data Bank entries (Memorysticks, Documents, or Passcodes).
achievements.summary: Collect 200 Memory Sticks, Documents, or Passcodes.

guide.context: 186 Memory Sticks, 112 Documents, and 23 Passcodes exist. Only new pickups count, not items taken in an earlier playthrough. Lily's bar fills as you collect them, which matters for the endings.

steps.text: Pick up every Memory Stick, Document, and Passcode you see until you have 200.

guide.context: Fishing starts with the side quest "Looking Glass". Clyde sells bait and fishing data for points. Turn on "Fishing Controls Replacement" in the accessibility settings to make it easier.

steps.text: Finish "Looking Glass" in the @loc{Great Desert} to unlock fishing and Clyde's shop.
Fish at the oasis in the @loc{Great Desert} and the pond on the path from @loc{Xion} to the @loc{Wasteland}.
Match bait to size: Small Shrimp for small fish, Wriggling Insect for medium, Fish Slice for large, Special Bait for gigantic.
Buy Fishing Data from Clyde to catch bigger fish.

guide.context: About 295 boxes exist, so you can skip some. Only boxes you have not opened before count.

steps.text: Open boxes as you explore each area until the count reaches 200.

guide.context: Each type is recorded when you defeat it. The Cocoon Naytiba lives only in Eidos 9, so visit it before Spire 4. Before the final area you should have 63 of 67; the final 3 only appear in the Colony ending.

steps.text: Defeat every Naytiba type you meet while exploring each area.
Visit @loc{Eidos 9} and defeat the Cocoon Naytiba.
Get the last 3 entries in the final area; they only appear if you chose the Colony ending.

guide.context: You should have 87 Camps before the second point of no return. The rest are in the final area.

steps.text: Activate every Camp in each area before finishing @loc{Spire 4}.
Activate the last Camps in the final area.

achievements.summary: Upgrade 10 Exospines to their maximum level.

guide.context: There are 12 Exospines. Each has 3 tiers, upgraded with Nano Elements and gold. You only need 10 at the top tier.

steps.text: Find Exospines in crates across @loc{Eidos 7}, the @loc{Wasteland}, @loc{Matrix 11}, the @loc{Great Desert}, and @loc{Spire 4}.
Upgrade 10 of them through all 3 tiers.

achievements.description: Enhanced Blood Edge to its max.
achievements.summary: Upgrade the Blood Edge to its maximum level.

guide.context: 15 Weapon Cores and 6 Damaged Weapon Cores exist for the Blood Edge.

steps.text: Collect Weapon Cores and Damaged Weapon Cores and use them to upgrade the Blood Edge until it is maxed.

achievements.description: Enhanced the Rechargeable Tumbler to its max.
achievements.summary: Upgrade the Rechargeable Tumbler to its maximum level.

guide.context: 15 Tumbler Expansion Modules exist.

steps.text: Collect Tumbler Expansion Modules and use them to upgrade the Rechargeable Tumbler until it is maxed.

achievements.summary: Upgrade HP to its maximum level.

guide.context: 20 Body Cores exist.

steps.text: Collect Body Cores and use them to raise your HP until it is maxed.

achievements.description: Enhanced Beta Energy to its max.
achievements.summary: Upgrade Beta Energy to its maximum level.

guide.context: 20 Beta Cores exist.

steps.text: Collect Beta Cores and use them to raise your Beta Energy until it is maxed.

guide.context: There are 96 skills. New Game+ skills are not needed. Training Gear gives extra SP.

steps.text: Earn SP by defeating enemies and finishing quests.
Spend SP until every skill is learned.
If you are short late in the game, farm the enemies behind the big left door past the Space Center Camp in @loc{Spire 4}; resting at the Camp respawns them.

achievements.summary: Complete the three side quests in Enya and Su's storyline.

steps.text: Do "Looking at You" in @loc{Xion} once the Altess Levoire mission is given.
Do "Keeping Secrets" once you have handed over the second Hyper Drive.
Do "Madame Machine" after reaching the @loc{Great Desert} and finishing "CnL – Communicate and Link".

achievements.summary: Complete the two side quests in Kaya's storyline.

steps.text: Finish "The Scavenger's Story", which Kaya gives you at Sisters' Junk.
Finish "Encounter" after beating the Alpha Naytiba in @loc{Matrix 11}.

achievements.summary: Complete the two side quests in D1G-g2r's storyline.

steps.text: Do "Plan to Clean the Earth" when you first enter the @loc{Wasteland}.
Reach Affinity level 2 with @npc{D1G-g2r}, then do "CnL – Communicate and Link".

guide.context: Blink and Repulse dodges do not count.

steps.text: Spend 1 SP on the Perfect Dodge skill (Survival tree).
Dodge just before an attack hits you; the game slows briefly with red particles when it works.
Learn Reflex Boost (2 SP) or equip the Reflex-Type Exospine to widen the timing.
Press parry just before an attack lands, so you deflect it and take no damage.
Learn Focus Boost (2 SP, Survival tree) or equip the Reflex-Type Exospine to widen the timing.
Spend 1 SP on the Ambush skill (Attack tree).
Sneak behind an enemy and execute it.
Hold the Beta button and press a face button to use a Beta Skill, and keep using them in normal fights.

guide.context: Burst Skills unlock after you beat Stalker, and none are learned by default.

steps.text: Learn Burst Skills in the skill tree.
Hold the Burst button and press a face button to use one, and use them on groups.

achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies while in Tachy Mode.

guide.context: Tachy Mode unlocks after you beat Tachy. The gauge fills as you defeat enemies and drains when you are hit.

steps.text: Fill the Tachy gauge and activate Tachy Mode.
Defeat 50 ordinary enemies while it is active.

guide.context: The sword is disabled in Altess Levoire and Abyss Levoire, so kills there count towards this.

steps.text: Use ranged attacks to defeat enemies, especially in @loc{Altess Levoire} and @loc{Abyss Levoire}.
Defeat enemies as you play until the total reaches 1,500.
Finish the story once to unlock @mechanic{New Game+}.
Start New Game+ and finish the story again; the lowest difficulty is fine and cutscenes can be skipped.

achievements.description: Learned all skills in New Game +.
achievements.summary: Learn all skills in New Game+.

guide.context: New Game+ adds 12 skills that cost 6 SP each. Burst and Beta trees cannot be reset, but the Attack, Survival, and Tachy trees can be reset to free up SP.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{New Game+} and earn at least 72 SP.
Learn the 4 Beta, 4 Extreme Enhancement, and 4 Burst New Game+ skills at the ends of their branches.
Reset the Attack, Survival, or Tachy tree if you need more SP.
